_comment: Sidecar overrides used by Phase 15 to replace the hand-rolled Schema with the generator's output. Drives the resolution metadata onto the emitted Schema struct via goAdditionalFields. Pending gaps before this can fully replace schema.go: per-property goType overrides for SchemaObject.Type (currently emits *any, need *Type), and a way to opt the boolean variant accessor into the existing TypeBool() name.
